title: ML-DSA (FIPS 204) Constant-Time Arithmetic & NTT Butterfly
description: Verify a complete 7-stage branchless, constant-time, overflow-free modular arithmetic pipeline for NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA (q = 8,380,417)—from centered reduction, Power2Round, and Montgomery reduction up to the Cooley-Tukey NTT butterfly.

tasks.title: Constant-time centered reduction mod q
tasks.description: Implement branchless centered_mod(a: i32) -> i32 mapping [0, q) into [-HALF_Q, HALF_Q] with zero unsafe, branches, or division/modulo.

tasks.title: Constant-time conditional i32 select
tasks.description: Implement branchless ct_select_i32(cond: u32, a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 returning a when cond != 0 else b with zero secret-dependent control flow.

tasks.title: FIPS 204 Montgomery reduction (R = 2^32)
tasks.description: Implement branchless montgomery_reduce(a: i64) -> i32 using QINV = 58728449 so |r| < q and r * 2^32 ≡ a (mod q) for all a in [-(2^31-1)*q, (2^31-1)*q].

tasks.title: FIPS 204 Power2Round (d = 13 bits)
tasks.description: Implement branchless power2round(r: i32) -> (i32, i32) decomposing every r in [0, q) into (r1, r0) with r = r1*2^13 + r0 and -2^12 < r0 <= 2^12.

tasks.title: Constant-time centered modular addition
tasks.description: Compose centered_mod and ct_select_i32 to implement branchless add_centered(a, b) for centered residues in [-HALF_Q, HALF_Q].

tasks.title: Constant-time centered modular subtraction
tasks.description: Compose centered_mod and ct_select_i32 to implement branchless sub_centered(a, b) returning (a - b) mod± q in [-HALF_Q, HALF_Q].

tasks.title: ML-DSA Cooley-Tukey NTT butterfly
tasks.description: Compose montgomery_reduce, add_centered, and sub_centered into a constant-time NTT butterfly returning (a + zeta*b, a - zeta*b) mod± q.
